description.zh: 按一下快捷键，当前窗口就一直显示在其他窗口上面，再按一下取消；也可以在搜索框里输入“置顶”挑一个窗口。管理员身份运行的窗口改不了
description.en: One shortcut keeps the window in front above the others, and takes it off again; or type “top” in the search box and pick a window. Not for windows run as administrator

description.zh: 打开的窗口；置顶、取消置顶
description.en: The open windows; on top, or no longer

hint.en: Enter to keep on top or take off

title.zh: 置顶 / 取消置顶当前窗口
title.en: Keep the window in front on top, or take it off

hint.zh: 窗口上会出现“已置顶”或“已取消置顶”；留空就不用快捷键
hint.en: The window says “On top” or “No longer on top”; leave empty for no shortcut
